name: flight
description: Flight — full system. Board/charter/buy aircraft at six airfields, fly the map_world tile grid on a real-time posture tick loop (heading/throttle/altitude bands/fuel), through interactive takeoff + glideslope minigames. Phase B hazards (stall/fire/weather/bird), no-fly airspace enforcement, cargo/passenger + smuggling contracts, ground AA + air combat + shootdowns, hangars, wreck salvage/rebuild, and deep tuning. The aircraft is a first-class object owning its occupant set; the cockpit HUD is synthesized. Piloting skill gates flight; Fabrication/Chemistry gate repair/rebuild.
